record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare WONDER_ROOM: Elgyem (1 star) and Beheeyem (2 stars), both maxPP 90, range 2. The strategy has no star table, so both behave identically. The identifier WONDER_ROOM is also the name of an EffectEnum flag (routing uncertainty NAME_SHARED_WITH_EFFECT): the ability sets that flag and the flag is consumed in pokemon-state.ts; no other source adds it.
record.summary: Marks every enemy in the 3x3 block centred on the cast target (target cell included) with the WONDER_ROOM effect for 5000 ms. While an enemy has the flag, (a) a basic attack against it is converted to SPECIAL (and then multiplied by the attacker's AP) and (b) inside handleDamage its DEF and SPE_DEF are swapped. The ability deals no damage itself, has no AP, star or crit scaling, and no tables.

targeting.who: every enemy-team unit in the cast target's cell and its 8 neighbours
targeting.note: requiresTarget is true (default), so the caster casts at a chosen target; the 3x3 block is centred on that target, not on the caster. Allies, empty cells and off-board cells are skipped. Which unit is the cast target comes from generic targeting, not read.

geometry.shape: 3x3 square centred on the cast target (centre included), clipped by the board bounds

effects.target: each enemy in the 3x3 block around the cast target
effects.scaling: none: the duration is the literal 5000 and the strategy reads no AP, stars or crit. effects is a set, so recasting on a unit that already has the flag adds nothing; each cast still queues its own DelayedCommand that deletes the flag unconditionally, so the earlier cast's command removes it at its own time even if a later cast was meant to extend it (the flag is not refreshed, the first expiring command wins).
effects.resolution: applied = flag present from the cast until a delayed delete runs. SimulationCommand.update fires the delete on the first update where the remaining delay is strictly below 0, so the real duration is 5000 ms plus up to one update step. No immunity, Rune Protect or protect check exists in this strategy: the flag is added unconditionally to each enemy found.

effects.effect: effect consumers (not part of the strategy)
effects.target: the flagged unit when it is attacked or damaged
effects.scaling: Basic attack path (PokemonState.attack): if the TARGET has WONDER_ROOM, attackType becomes SPECIAL, and the damage is then multiplied by (1 + attacker AP / 100), rounded up. Damage path (PokemonState.handleDamage): for the unit taking damage, def and speDef are first halved (rounded) if armorReduction, then swapped; PHYSICAL damage is divided by the swapped def (= original SPE_DEF) and SPECIAL by the swapped speDef (= original DEF); TRUE damage ignores both.
effects.resolution: The flag changes which defensive stat applies and, for basic attacks, the damage type and AP factor. It does not change HP, shields or the minimum-1 rule. An ability hit keeps the type it was dealt with (WONDER_ROOM converts only basic attacks), but its defence stat is swapped. Requested vs applied: no amount is requested by the ability; the effect on damage depends on the DEF / SPE_DEF values and the attacker's AP, not examined numerically here.

starBehavior.note: No star-indexed table or branch in the strategy; the two units differ only in stats listed in the unit blocks.

record.positionalConditions: Only the 3x3 block around the cast target (clipped at the board edge) and the team test matter.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state. Each cast spends maxPP PP (floor 0) and queues one more 5000 ms delete command per affected enemy. Because the flag is a set entry and every delete is unconditional, overlapping casts do not extend the duration: the earliest queued delete ends it.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: flag for 5000 ms on each enemy in the block; no damage or stat amount. Applied: flag present until the first matching delayed delete runs (at least 5000 ms; the command fires when its delay is strictly below 0). Consumer effects (basic attack becomes SPECIAL with AP; DEF and SPE_DEF swap after armorReduction halving) depend on the damaged unit's stats and the attacker's AP and were not evaluated numerically.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Which unit is the cast target and when the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence, targeting) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
How and when the simulation updates entity commands (the update loop calling SimulationCommand.update) was not read; only the strict-below-0 test in update() was
Whether a commands list is cleared when the unit dies or the round ends was not read
Damage resolution paths other than the two WONDER_ROOM lines (flat reductions, Shiny Charm, Fossil, Cover Band) were not traced for this ability
unresolved: Routing uncertainty NAME_SHARED_WITH_EFFECT: Ability.WONDER_ROOM (this strategy) and EffectEnum.WONDER_ROOM (the flag) share a name; a search for EffectEnum.WONDER_ROOM in app/core and app/models found only the strategy's add/delete and the two reads in pokemon-state.ts (attack at line 85, handleDamage at line 516), but synergy/item code outside those folders was not searched
Other damage-dealing paths that bypass PokemonState.attack or handleDamage's def/speDef lines were not searched, so 'every damage swaps defences' is only established for handleDamage
Whether the swap interacts with Rune/Protective effects that read def or speDef elsewhere (e.g. other stat-reading abilities) was not examined
Whether the two units ever reach a different star count than the bare factory value
No gameplay evidence; candidate is source reading plus mechanical checks only
